uz.c3: Buyumni yuborish uchun 24 soat. Ulgurmasa — buyurtma bekor qilinadi, xaridor pulini qaytarib oladi.
uz.c4: Buyum kelmasa, xaridor nizo ochadi. Administratsiya ko'rib chiqmaguncha to'lov muzlatiladi.
uz.c5: To'lov — faqat o'z kartangizdan, qaytarish — faqat pul kelgan joyga. Yangi akkauntlar uchun limitlar bor. Tizim bog'langan akkauntlar va shubhali bitimlarni qidiradi.
uz.c6: Bitimning har bir qadami qayd etiladi: to'lov, yuborish, tasdiqlash, to'lov. Tarix ilovada doim mavjud.
uz.no_gambling: 🚫 DGhostMarket — o'yinchilar o'rtasidagi bitimlar uchun platforma. Biz qimor o'yinlari o'tkazmaymiz, keyslar sotmaymiz va stavkalar qabul qilmaymiz. O'yinlar bepul: ishtirok uchun to'lov talab qilinmaydi.

uz.q4: Platforma Valve yoki Steam bilan bog'liqmi?

uz.a5: Telegram'da @DGhostMarket_Support ga yoki support@dghostmarket.uz manziliga yozing — 24 soat ichida javob beramiz. Muayyan bitim bo'yicha to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ilovadan yozish qulayroq.

en._title: DGhostMarket — CS2 skin marketplace in Telegram
en._description: Buy and sell CS2 skins for Uzbek sum in Telegram. Payment is held until the item arrives, sellers are verified, 5% fee.
en._og_description: Safe CS2 skin deals: verified sellers, 24-hour transfer, payout after 8 days.
en.trust_hold: 🔒 Payment is held until you receive the skin
en.hero_title: Buy and sell CS2 skins for sum
en.hero_lead: DGhostMarket connects skin buyers and sellers. The platform holds the payment until the item reaches the buyer, and sellers verify their identity.
en.how_sub: The item moves directly between Steam accounts, while the platform watches the deadlines and holds the payment until the deal is complete.
en.b1: A catalog with filters by weapon, quality, float and price.
en.b2: By transfer from your own card with a receipt, or from your balance. The platform holds the money — the seller doesn't get it yet.
en.b3: The seller sends a Steam trade within 24 hours. If not — you're refunded the same way you paid.
en.b4: Accept the trade in Steam and tap “Received”. Something wrong — open a dispute.
en.s1: Phone number via Telegram, a document photo and a selfie — once, before your first listing.
en.s2: Straight from your Steam inventory: photo, float and stickers are filled in, and the app suggests the market price. List your whole inventory at once with “All at market −3%”.
en.s3: After payment, send the Steam trade and mark it as “Sent”.
en.s4: 8 days after payment, the amount minus 5% lands on your balance. Withdrawals to your own card carry no platform fee.
en.fees_sub: No hidden charges: every amount is shown before you confirm.
en.fee_buyer_p: You pay the price on the listing. If a payment method charges a fee, the total is shown before payment.
en.fee_seller_p: The platform's fee on a sold item. It's the platform's only income from a deal.
en.fee_withdraw_p: From your balance to a bank card with no platform fee. Minimum — 50,000 sum.
en.safe_sub: Platform rules protect both sides: the buyer and the seller.
en.c1: Passport or ID, a selfie with the document and a phone number confirmed via Telegram. An admin makes the decision.
en.c2: Money is held for 8 days from payment — longer than Steam allows a trade to be reversed, and longer for higher-risk deals. Only then does it go to the seller.
en.c3: 24 hours to transfer the item. Miss it — the order is cancelled and the buyer is refunded.
en.c4: If the item doesn't arrive, the buyer opens a dispute. The payout is frozen until the admins sort it out.
en.c5: Pay only from your own card; refunds go only back where the money came from. New accounts have limits. The system looks for linked accounts and suspicious deals.
en.c6: Every step is recorded: payment, transfer, confirmation, payout. The history is always available in the app.
en.no_gambling: 🚫 DGhostMarket is a platform for deals between players. We don't run gambling, don't sell cases and don't accept bets. Giveaways are free: no payment is required to take part.
en.q1: What if the seller doesn't transfer the item?
en.a1: If within 24 hours of payment the seller hasn't marked the transfer and the item isn't in your Steam inventory, the order is cancelled automatically and you get your money back.
en.q2: Why does the seller get paid after 8 days?
en.a2: Steam allows a trade to be reversed within 7 days. The platform holds the payment a little longer so the buyer isn't left without the item, and the seller isn't left without the money.
en.q3: Do buyers need to get verified?
en.a3: Not for regular purchases: just sign in with Telegram and add your Steam trade link. For a large purchase, or once a new account hits its limit, the platform will ask you to verify your identity. Sellers are verified before their first listing.
en.q4: Is the platform affiliated with Valve or Steam?
en.a4: No. DGhostMarket is an independent platform. Items move via standard Steam trades between users' accounts.
en.a5: Message @DGhostMarket_Support on Telegram or email support@dghostmarket.uz — we reply within 24 hours. For a specific deal, it's easiest to write from the app.
en.docs_sub: The rules the platform runs on, in Uzbek and Russian. We announce changes at least 30 days in advance.
en.d4s: What data we keep and why
en.rq_owner_v: Sole proprietor Akhmadbekov Nodirbek Sardorbek ugli
en.final_sub: Open DGhostMarket in Telegram — you sign in with Telegram, no separate sign-up needed.
en.disclaimer: DGhostMarket is not affiliated with Valve Corporation. CS2, Counter-Strike and Steam are trademarks of Valve Corporation.
en.v3_title: The skin in 3D and on your desk
en.v3_sub: See the exact item you're buying, not a stock Steam image.
en.v3_1: Rotate the skin, zoom into details, switch the background to a CS2 map. Models are built from the game files.
en.v3_2: From your phone, place the skin on a desk or floor at real size: a knife is about 25 cm, an AK about 88 cm.
en.v3_3: Wear, pattern and stickers are shown as on that exact listing, with the price next to the market price.
en.sel_sub: Listing is free. Plans are for those who want more reach and sell through their own Telegram channel.
en.sel_1: A spinning 3D clip of your listing instead of a plain image — for chats and channels.
en.sel_2: To @dghostmarket and your own channels in one tap — with a “Buy” button under the post.
en.sel_3: Right in your channel: bids in the mini app, payment through escrow, the bot picks the giveaway winner.
en.sel_note: For large channels and shops we discuss custom terms — contact support.
en.q6: Can I pay with someone else's card?
en.a6: No. When paying by transfer you enter the cardholder's name, and you can only pay from your own card. A payment from someone else's card is declined and refunded to the sender's card.
en.q7: How and when are refunds made?
en.a7: The same way you paid: to your balance right away, to a card within 3 banking days of the refund decision. Refunds are never sent to other cards or accounts.
en.sc_title: Every skin in 3D, just like in the game
en.sc_1: The marketplace holds the money until the skin reaches your Steam.
en.sc_2_t: The exact item in 3D and AR
en.sc_2: Float, pattern and stickers match the listing. Put the knife on your desk with your phone camera.
en.sc_3: No dollars or crypto: pay from your own card, with the market price shown alongside.
